About the school

Strong values, strong foundations

Founded to give families in our community access to quality English-medium education, Tabitha combines good teaching with character, discipline and care in the years that matter most.

Our teachers know each child by name. Small classes, regular assessments and close contact with parents mean no student falls behind unnoticed. Alongside their lessons, children enjoy sport, music, art and play, so they move on to secondary school confident, kind and capable.

HopeIntegrityRespectCuriosityExcellenceService
From the Principal
"Our goal is simple: that every child who walks through our gates leaves able to think clearly, speak confidently and treat others with respect. We see education as a partnership between school and home, and our doors are always open to parents."

Academics

Learning at every stage

A clear path from first letters to the end of primary school, taught in English from the very first day.

Nursery

Early Years

Gentle, play-based learning for our youngest children.

  • Songs, stories and rhymes
  • Colours, shapes and counting
  • Learning to share and play
Reception

Pre-School

Getting ready for primary with early reading and number skills.

  • Phonics & letter sounds
  • Writing and drawing
  • Spoken English every day
Standard 1 – 4

Foundation Years

Firm foundations in reading, writing and mathematics.

  • English, Maths, Science
  • Reading time every day
  • Art, music and PE
Standard 5 – 7

Ready for Secondary

Growing independence and confidence for the next step.

  • Social studies & science
  • Homework support
  • Preparation for the PSLE
A school day

Structured, balanced and on time

A sample day for primary classes. Every day starts with assembly and includes time to play outside.

TimeActivity
7:30 – 7:50Morning assembly & prayer
7:50 – 10:00English and Mathematics

12:30 – 1:15Lunch and play

Admissions

Joining Tabitha

Admissions for 2027 are open for pre-school and primary classes. Seats are limited in each class, so we encourage families to apply early.

Enquire or visit

Call the office or book a campus tour to meet our staff and see the classrooms.

Submit the form

Collect the admission form from the office or fill in the enquiry form below.

Assessment & interaction

A short, friendly meeting with your child and a chat with parents.

Confirm the seat

Submit documents and fees to confirm. We'll share the uniform and book list.

Documents you'll need

Birth certificate · Previous school report card · Transfer letter (if changing schools) · 2 passport photos · Parent ID
